facts.statement: Free Realms was listed among SOE games offering bonus XP events and offers during a President's Day weekend in February 2011.
facts.quote: Bonus XP events and offers will be available for EverQuest , EverQuest II , Star Wars Galaxies , Free Realms , Vanguard

article_summaries.title: SOE Hosts Weekend XP Bonus Events and Discounts for President's Day
article_summaries.summary: This is a multi-game Ten Ton Hammer news post announcing SOE's President's Day weekend of bonus XP events and Marketplace discounts across several titles. Free Realms is named only in a single sentence in its list of participating games, with no event details, dates, rates or offers given, so the article adds little for a rebuild beyond confirming a February 2011 weekend XP event.
